enumeration_method.boundary_root_bound: a weakly one-sign contact has proper support, whose identity and conjugate Grams are both positive definite
enumeration_method.conjugate_bound: G^sigma is positive definite and h^sigma(c,c)=2
enumeration_method.mixed_root_identity_bound: for I={c_i>0}, J={c_i<0}, the nonpositive off-diagonal Gram gives h(c_I,c_I)+h(c_J,c_J)<=2; both proper principal Grams are positive definite
enumeration_method.ring_coordinate_bound: for x=a+b*phi, Tr(x^2)=2a^2+2ab+3b^2; inverse-diagonal bounds turn the two-place bounds into finite integer boxes
